canonical_project: PMICE Koumra digital-infrastructure sites (fiber, transmission pylons, multimedia center, SOTEL installations)
owner: PMICE (Projet de Modernisation des Infrastructures de Communications Electroniques) - Ministry of Telecommunications; Huawei delivery partner
notes: Minister Boukar Michel inspected PMICE digital infrastructure in Mandoul (Koumra) in early May 2025: fiber-optic sites, transmission pylons, a multimedia center and SOTEL installations (WeAreTech, 6 May 2025). Koumra is on the PMICE Phase I national fiber route (Doba-Koumra-Sarh...). Phase I provisional reception acted at Sarh 20 Dec 2025; final technical reception of the 200 PMICE transmission sites still pending per 2026 reporting. Classified PMICE transmission/technical sites, NOT commercial DC.
